note: Real responses, captured read-only: the NHC ATCF best-track directory and each 2026 EP best-track file it lists (storms 01 to 49). Trimmed: the index to the matching links; each file to its BEST lines, one line per fix time (the 34-knot radii line), columns 1 to 28 (basin to storm name). The adapter reads basin, number, time, wind, type and name only.
